title: Sparkly alarm clock
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe066'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb300'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- Clock body -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='28' fill='#ff6b6b'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='24' fill='#ff9f43'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='20' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- Clock face -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='17' fill='#2c2c54'/>
  <!-- Hour markers -->
  <line x1='50' y1='41' x2='50' y2='45' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='65' x2='50' y2='69' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='36' y1='55' x2='40' y2='55' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='60' y1='55' x2='64' y2='55' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Clock hands -->
  <line x1='50' y1='55' x2='50' y2='44' stroke='#ff6b6b' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='55' x2='57' y2='58' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Bell left -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='30' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#4ecdc4' transform='rotate(-25 28 30)'/>
  <!-- Bell right -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='30' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#4ecdc4' transform='rotate(25 72 30)'/>
  <!-- Bell tops -->
  <circle cx='25' cy='25' r='3' fill='#7bedda'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='25' r='3' fill='#7bedda'/>
  <!-- Little feet -->
  <rect x='38' y='81' width='5' height='8' rx='2' fill='#4ecdc4'/>
  <rect x='57' y='81' width='5' height='8' rx='2' fill='#4ecdc4'/>
  <!-- Top handle -->
  <path d='M44 28 Q50 20 56 28' stroke='#4ecdc4' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffe066'>
    <polygon points='12,20 14,26 20,26 15,30 17,36 12,32 7,36 9,30 4,26 10,26'/>
    <polygon points='85,12 86.5,16 91,16 87.5,19 89,23 85,20 81,23 82.5,19 79,16 83.5,16'/>
    <polygon points='82,72 83.5,76 88,76 84.5,79 86,83 82,80 78,83 79.5,79 76,76 80.5,76'/>
    <polygon points='15,68 16.5,72 21,72 17.5,75 19,79 15,76 11,79 12.5,75 9,72 13.5,72'/>
    <polygon points='90,45 91.5,49 96,49 92.5,52 94,56 90,53 86,56 87.5,52 84,49 88.5,49'/>
    <polygon points='8,48 9.5,52 14,52 10.5,55 12,59 8,56 4,59 5.5,55 2,52 6.5,52'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Small sparkle dots -->
  <g fill='#ffffff'>
    <circle cx='22' cy='15' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='78' cy='62' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='85' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='30' cy='88' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='88' cy='35' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='12' cy='38' r='1.2'/>
  </g>
</svg>
